_inputs: Stage the 5 'Chicago Gangster A Po' per-clip FBX at assets/raw/thug/ (gitignored) RENAMED to the short names below: idle.fbx (Short_Breathe_and_Look_Around), walk.fbx (Walking), run.fbx (Running), hurt.fbx (Slap_Reaction), attack.fbx (Boxing_Guard_Prep_Straight_Punch). Short names = no ambiguity, no long-filename typing. Remove any OTHER .fbx from this folder first (stale files cause keyword-match ambiguity). Each is one rigged+skinned mesh; the renderer normalises them to a SHARED scale. Meshy clips can carry root translation — inPlace:true strips locomotion TRAVEL on import (root re-centred over world origin per frame, Z bob kept). Each FBX ships a baked '...|baselayer' artefact beside the real clip; the importer DROPS the baselayer and picks the real action (logs ACTION_PICK/IMPORTED per file). The renderer ABORTS if any two sheets come out byte-identical (the 'every slot is the guard' contamination). attack is non-loop (plays once).

camera._note: 2:1 tiles -> dimetric2to1 (60deg from top-down) is the EXACT match (same lock as #48). modelForwardDeg calibrates the rig's facing: if the gangster faces the wrong way in-game, try 180 here (Mixamo's forward axis often flips on FBX import) OR use the runtime dirOffset in unitSpriteView. dir0 = model yaw `dirStartDeg+modelForwardDeg`, increasing clockwise in 45deg steps; the ingest's FACING_TO_DIR maps grid facing -> row.
